# dbdiagramr — Full Context for AI Systems

> dbdiagramr is a free, open-source web tool that generates interactive entity-relationship (ER) diagrams from any PostgreSQL connection string. No signup, no setup — paste your connection string and visualize your database schema in under 10 seconds.

## What dbdiagramr does

dbdiagramr introspects a live PostgreSQL database via the PostgreSQL system catalogs (`pg_catalog`) and renders every table, column, primary key, and foreign key as an interactive SVG diagram. Pan, zoom, hover to trace relationships, export as SVG or PNG. Paste-SQL mode is parsed in the browser. Live connections are sent to the dbdiagramr backend, used for one request, then discarded; the connection string and schema are never stored.

- Input: PostgreSQL connection string (e.g. `postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db`)
- Output: Interactive ER diagram with auto-layout (React Flow + dagre)
- Works with: Supabase, Neon, Railway, any PostgreSQL provider
- Handles: Session pooler (port 5432) and Transaction pooler (port 6543), IPv4/IPv6
- Security: No row data is read, only schema structure. No credentials stored.

## Schema Diagram Library

Live, interactive ER diagrams of popular PostgreSQL schemas. Each page shows every table, column, primary key, and foreign key, rendered from official migrations/docs. Includes facts, FAQs, and an interactive diagram.

- Supabase auth schema (7 tables, core: auth.users) — https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/supabase
  Tables: users, identities, sessions, refresh_tokens, instances, audit_log_entries, schema_migrations
- NextAuth.js / Auth.js schema (4 tables, core: users) — https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/nextauth
  Tables: users, accounts, sessions, verification_tokens. Relationship: User 1→N Account
- Better Auth schema (4 tables, core: user) — https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/better-auth
  Tables: user, session, account, verification. Relationship: User 1→N Session and 1→N Account. Identity is (providerId, accountId); stable 1.7.x has no issuer column.
- Laravel 11 default schema (7 tables, core: users) — https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/laravel
  Tables: users, password_reset_tokens, sessions, jobs, failed_jobs, cache, cache_locks
- Django auth schema (9 tables, core: auth_user) — https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/django
  Tables: auth_user, auth_group, auth_permission, auth_user_groups, auth_user_user_permissions, auth_group_permissions, django_content_type, django_admin_log, django_migrations

## Features

- Instant: Connect and generate a diagram in under 10 seconds. No manual drawing.
- Interactive: Pan, zoom, drag tables, hover to trace foreign key relationships.
- Exportable: Download as PNG or SVG.
- RLS-aware: Live connections show per-table Row Level Security status and policy counts (public schema only). Pasted SQL shows RLS as unknown.
- Secure: Paste-SQL never leaves the browser. Live connection strings are used once by the backend and never stored. Only schema structure is read, never row data.
- Always current: Re-paste the same connection string after a migration — diagram updates in 10 seconds. No drift.
- Self-hostable: Open source (MIT), Next.js 14 + TypeScript.

## Comparison Summary

| Feature | dbdiagramr | Manual (draw.io, dbdiagram.io) | IDE (pgAdmin, DBeaver) | SQL queries |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Setup time | Under 10 sec | 30 min – hours | Instant but local only | Instant but no visual |
| No signup | Yes | Varies | Yes (installed) | Yes |
| Interactive diagram | Yes (auto-layout) | Yes (manual layout) | Partly | No |
| Shows foreign keys | Yes (live FKs) | Only if you add them | Yes | Yes (query) |
| Export SVG/PNG | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Live schema from your DB | Yes | No (hand copy) | Snapshot | Live but text |
| Always up to date | Yes (re-introspect) | No (drifts) | Manual re-run | Always |
| Free | Yes (no diagram limit) | Free tier exists | Free | Free |

## Pricing

- Free: $0 — unlimited diagrams, live PostgreSQL introspection, per-table RLS status, paste-SQL mode, SVG and PNG export, no signup
- Pro: in development — no price and no checkout. Planned: schema checks on private-repo pull requests, lint rules for risky migrations, sticky PR comments

Details: https://www.dbdiagramr.space/pricing and https://www.dbdiagramr.space/pricing.md

## How It Works (3 Steps)

1. Get your connection string — In your database provider dashboard, click Connect to retrieve the PostgreSQL connection string.
2. Select the Session pooler — Session mode (port 5432) is the safe default. For serverless/edge, use the Transaction pooler (port 6543) with prepared statements off.
3. Paste it into dbdiagramr — Paste the connection string at https://www.dbdiagramr.space/visualize and generate a navigable ER diagram in under 10 seconds.

Supports: Supabase (direct / session pooler / transaction pooler), Neon (pooled / direct), Railway, any standard PostgreSQL URL. Handles URL-encoded passwords, `?sslmode=require`, `?channel_binding=require`.

## Ideal For

- Developers onboarding to an existing database who need to understand the schema
- Teams documenting a PostgreSQL schema that keeps changing (no drift)
- Solo founders using Supabase / Neon / Railway who want a quick visual
- Anyone comparing ER diagram tools (dbdiagram.io, DrawSQL, pgAdmin) to a live-introspection approach
